name: dormant-sacrificial-altar-sacrifice-automaton-and-human-mills-two
notes: Dormant Sacrificial Altar (px8jypwc8t), Shieldroid (Automaton) and Coy Bouclier (Human) seeded on player 1's field. The Altar's ability is activated for real (10001 Activate:0), then the Automaton and the Human are chosen (the Human's index shifts to myField-2 once Shieldroid is spliced out). Top of the deck: Dungeon Guide, Fluffy Shopkeep (the two milled), Charge the Soul (marker: must be the new top card). Pre-fix the generated body milled with a loop of MZMove(myDeck-0), so only ONE card was milled (graveyard 3, deck 14).

rulesClauses: Sacrifice an Automaton ally and a Human ally: Put the top two cards of your deck into your graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated customDQHandlers["px8jypwc8t:0:ActivateAbility-2"] milled two cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myGraveyard"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on the second iteration and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever milled (live repro: graveyard 3, deck 14). Overridden in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MillCards().
